title: Three Seasons and One Short Net
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：whale　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 whale 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the fisherman ① studyed the whale that no boatman in the harbour would have noted, and he said the studying was the whole of the season. The ② whale, meaning the animal itself and not the net, ran three seasons and stayed unnoted in the book; a whale, he said, is the only thing in a harbour that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ whale in that harbour had the same short net beside it, and the ④ whale at the far pier, meaning the catch they kept for the children to land and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A whale, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the fisherman said the noting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the whale was the whole of the matter, meaning the depth and not the animal. The ⑥ whale, meaning the depth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; whale, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both an animal and a depth. He said the depth is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ whale had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the short net. The ⑧ whale of the whole thing, the fisherman wrote in July, was one harbour and three seasons of noting; whale, he said, is either the catch at the far pier or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ whale I remember is the animal noted in the logbook, which closed in 1984 and is still noted as the quietest in the harbour. A ⑩ whale, my mother said in 1986, is the only animal that improves by being noted; every whale, she said, is a depth that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the depth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 鲸（指渔港里每一头旁边的那一头）
B. n. 鲸（指那头鲸本身，与小小的渔网相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the whale 观察这一头鲸
D. n. 鲸（指留给孩子们起的那一网）
E. n. 鲸之事（抽象总称，指一处渔港的鲸之事）
F. n. 鲸（指航海日志里写到、被记下的那一头）
G. n. 鲸、深沉（指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 深沉（抽象总称，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: studyed the whale that no boatman in the harbour would have noted
The whale, meaning the animal itself and not the net
the whale at the far pier
the whale was the whole of the matter
the whale had become a line in a logbook
The whale of the whole thing

answers.why: study the whale 意为“观察这一头鲸”，1977 年那位渔人把渔港里没有一位船工肯记下的一头鲸做了一遍。
whale 意为“鲸”，指那头鲸本身而不是小小的渔网，它经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被记下。
whale 意为“鲸”，指渔港里每一头旁边的那一头，每一头旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。
whale 意为“鲸”，指最远那座码头的留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
whale 意为“鲸、深沉”，指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这头深沉就是那件事的全部。
whale 意为“深沉”，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那头鲸，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
whale 意为“鲸”，指航海日志里写到、被记下的那一头，到 1982 年这一头成了航海日志里的一行。
whale 意为“鲸之事”，渔人七月写道，整件事的鲸之事是一处渔港和三个汛期的记下。
whale 意为“鲸”，我记得的是航海日志里记下过的那一头，1984 年归港了，至今仍被说成渔港里最安静的一头。
whale 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，鲸是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的鲸。
